errors.error_description: A localparam declaration is missing a terminating semicolon, violating basic SystemVerilog syntax structure rules.
A primitive buffer is instantiated with a 4-bit output driven by a 1-bit input, causing a port width mismatch at the instance boundary.
State-holding outputs are assigned in an always block triggered by level-sensitive signals (clk and rst_n) instead of a proper edge-sensitive clock, improperly mixing sequential behavior.
A signal is declared but never used, representing dead code and potential optimization stripping.
